meta.name: add-tavily-tool
meta.description: Add Tavily Search and Extract as keyless remote MCP tools for selected NanoClaw agent groups. Use when installing Tavily web search or URL extraction without an API key.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 添加免密钥的搜索与网页提取能力到智能体组
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果在用 NanoClaw 管理智能体，希望它们能直接搜索网页和提取内容
copy.tagline_en: Add keyless web search and extraction to your agent groups.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage NanoClaw agents and want them to search the web without an API key.

howto.what: 为指定的 NanoClaw agent group 注册 Tavily 远程 MCP,提供 tavily_search(网页搜索)和 tavily_extract(网页提取)两个工具,无需 API key。额度用尽时 agent 会主动给出改用付费 key 的指引。
howto.when: 当你要在 NanoClaw 的 agent group 里安装 Tavily 网页搜索或 URL 提取、且不使用 API key 时使用;技能会先检查镜像与 group 列表。

say.text: 看一下这个 group 的 tavily 服务器配置和两个请求头。
Tavily 返回 429 了,把升级到付费 key 的指引装上。
say.note: 写入升级说明块并重启 group

howto.what_en: Registers Tavily's remote MCP server for selected NanoClaw agent groups, adding two keyless tools: tavily_search and tavily_extract. It also adds upgrade instructions so the agent offers a paid API key once the keyless allowance runs out.
howto.when_en: Use when installing Tavily web search or URL extraction for NanoClaw agent groups without an API key. The skill checks the image manifest and lists groups first.

say_en.text: Add Tavily search and extract to this agent group, no API key.
Show this group's tavily MCP server config and its two headers.
Tavily returned 429 - install the paid-key upgrade instructions.
say_en.note: Writes the upgrade block, then restarts.
